task.title: 修复重工具会话无法压缩（history_too_short）并接线 RequiresRequestMutation 溢出自救
task.description: 独立 worktree 彻底不采纳 512KiB 客户端拦截；1) 补齐 native transcript token 计量；2) compression/compaction_ops 切分计入 provider_native_transcript；3) retry.rs 修正 400/413 溢出优先级；4) overflow_rescue 接入 turn_stream/turn_sync 自动受控压缩重发。

evidence: 独立 worktree (fix/compaction-and-overflow-rescue) 基于 origin/main (5689825f) 实施，彻底不采纳客户端 512KiB 拦截：1) compression::estimate_native_message_tokens 补齐 reasoning_content/tool_calls/tool_call_id 计量；2) compression::split_history_with_transcript 与 apply_compression_with_transcript 计入 provider_native_transcript 体积，解决重工具会话 80% 自动压缩与 /compact 返回 history_too_short；3) 新增 trim_native_transcript_to_token_budget（保持 user 锚点与闭合工具往返）与 overflow_rescue.rs 接线 RequiresRequestMutation 单次受控自救；4) retry.rs 修正 400/413 携带明确溢出关键词时优先映射 UpstreamContextOverflow。验证：size:check 0 新增；adr:check PASS；rust:lint PASS (3845/3870, 新增 0)；contract:bin-imports PASS (50/50)；cargo-lane test --lib 99 passed；compression_acceptance 6 passed；slash_commands_acceptance 300 passed；release 编译并原子替换 ~/.local/bin/{pony,ponycli,pony-tui}。ADR: .agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-11-24-native-compaction-split-and-overflow-rescue.md
